description: This file defines the TopicsScreen widget, a stateful component in a Flutter app that displays a list of topics with filtering options, recent topics, and a responsive grid of topic tiles with animations and user interactions.

classes.description: A stateful widget that renders a topics listing screen with filtering, recent topics, and a grid of topic tiles.

classes.description: The internal state class managing the filtering, recent topics, and UI interactions for TopicsScreen.

methods.description: Displays a SnackBar message in response to user interactions.
